posts.text:
Worth it.


Teddy Schleifer (@teddyschleifer)

Tom Steyer spent $558 million over the last six years on two races to remain a private citizen.



— https://nitter.net/teddyschleifer/status/2064495270365151682#m

“Good morning. It’s Thursday. Thumb guy disappeared in the middle of the night. Very mysterious. But the special lady took us out and I’m feeling a little better and she said he’d bring treats. Also, I love you.”
“Good morning. It’s Friday. Don’t be frightened by my collar. It’s for scaring away mean dogs. At least that’s what they told me. Also, I love you.”
I forgot I’ve had an account here since 2023. Kicking the tires now.
Giving this a whirl. This is my first Bluesky post and, yes, I'm tweeting pictures of my dogs. Don't say you weren't warned.
